title: An HQ tab left open keeps running the old version after an update, with no word to reload
what: HQ is meant to stay open all day: it checks Needs you every minute, so the page is never reloaded on its own. After an update goes live, that open tab (or the installed phone app brought back from the background) keeps the old screens and old buttons until you reload by hand. Nothing tells you a newer version is out. An old button can then send what the server no longer accepts and you only see 'Something in the form is missing or wrong'.
expected: When a newer HQ is live, the open page says 'HQ was updated, reload' (or reloads itself when nothing is being typed).
how_often: after every HQ update while a tab is open
fix_line: Let the minute check notice a new HQ version and show a Reload line

items.reason: Fresh install and update: pages and scripts are served no-store, the service worker keeps only the offline page and drops old caches on update, icons are renamed -v2. A database without the trial update shows a plain 'needs the database update' line. Watch, sideload and Play packages do not exist for HQ (a web panel). Fault: an already-open tab never picks up a new version.

Trial end and plan end use India days (last day, ended today, payment due since); month adding holds the day (31 Jan + 1 month = 28/29 Feb), so leap day and year end are handled; CSV name uses the India date. Gym pause and un-pause, sign out everywhere and a new owner sign-in code (owner changes phone) exist. Known faults reused: the ended tile mixes lapsed plans, the stage words, the 30-day sign-in jump, un-pause marks checked. Member leaves and returns: not in HQ. Noted, not a finding: a paid-until date in the past is accepted when setting a plan by hand.

The free trial rule was given to gyms that already existed (the database update set their start to that day). The new-gym check only counts gyms made in the last 14 days, so older unchecked gyms drop off Needs you (existing finding).
Older gyms got a trial on the update day; older unchecked gyms still show 'Not checked yet' on the gym list with a Mark checked button.
Rule applied: no new finding; the one gap is already written.

HQ has no What's new or update marks. On a first open the alert step compares with nothing and stays quiet; alerts are off until the button is pressed. 'New this week' is about the gym's age, not the viewer.
Rule applied: no new mark on old things found.
